Almeria, a team in Spain's top division, has hired Sergi Barjuan as their new head coach. Barjuan, 43, is the third coach this season. He replaces Juan Ignacio Martinez, who was fired on Sunday. The team had just lost 4-1 to Levante. Barjuan will coach the team's game against Barcelona on Wednesday. Barjuan used to play for Barcelona. He also played for the Spanish national team 53 times between 1998 and 204. He played for Barcelona for nine years. He played in two World Cups for Spain. He was a coach for Recreativo in Spain's second division from 2012 to 2014.
